content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (RENEWAL), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clause:** Subparagraph 18.1 (p0228) — 25-year Initial Period, then evergreen continuation, exit only on "not less than one (1) year's prior notice." That is a ~365-day non-renewal notice window: it fails the 60-day fallback ceiling and sits in walk-away territory (>90 days).
- **Other locations checked:** 18.2–18.7 (p0229–p0235) offer no shorter exit (unanimity, decommissioning votes, exit accounting only); no "renew"/"renewal term"/price-uplift language exists anywhere; pricing is actual Capital Costs and O&M Costs shared in Schedule B proportions (p0147) with 11.3 confirming no additional charges (p0182), so the conditional price-cap element is already met.
- **Redline:** one surgical insertion giving Teleglobe USA a 60-day window, keeping every other word verbatim and leaving the one-year period for the other Parties — shortening their notice would deprive us of warning before we must absorb a withdrawing Party's obligations under 18.5.
